# Taylor — Encounter, Region, Name, and Count (2026)

## Provenance identity

Frank G. Taylor supplied this authorial etymological synthesis on 2 August 2026 while preparing the Taoist quilting layer. Its governing proposition is that encounter is prior to naming and counting: the *with* is given first, while name and number are differentiating operations within that prior facing. The convergent histories of *com-/con-/contra*, region and *Gegend*, count and countenance, Greek gathering, Sanskrit enumeration, and Chinese facing-region language give the proposition a multilingual historical body.

This record preserves the derivation as internal authorship. Public lexical and textual claims resolve to the relevant dictionaries, primary texts, and scholarly source houses. The QL application resolves to [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md|Taylor — Core Theorems Pithy (2026)]] and the live argument nodes; it does not require an external tradition to authorise it.

## Authorial derivation

The word-field unfolds one movement. *Com-* gives being-with; *contra* gives the with turned into counter-facing; *continentia* gives the way a person holds together before another; *computare* gives the pruning by which something becomes countable; *comes* gives the one who goes-with. These are distinct branches rather than one lexical descent, yet their English convergence makes the common operation audible: a determination is reckoned-with, held-with, faced, or accompanied only inside a prior relational field.

Region carries the same fork. *Regio* belongs to drawing straight, directing, and ruling: the domain as a line made authoritative. *Gegend* belongs to counter-position and encounter: the expanse in which something can face and be faced. Heidegger's *Gegnet* reactivates the second constitution as the open that regions, gathers, abides, and lets things rest in their own appearing. The QL distinction is exact: the field precedes the sovereign line drawn within it; rule is one determination of region, not region's source.

Countenance joins the field to personhood. It names self-holding as appearance before another: not an interior substance subsequently displayed, but a bearing whose form arises in encounter. Face, presence, mask, person, image, counter-image, and echo all belong to this return circuit. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map|Bimba-Pratibimba]] gives the QL mirror structure: a mark displays its source in another orientation without becoming a second self-grounding thing.

Counting then appears as differentiated action rather than neutral enumeration. Its histories carry fitting, straightening, pruning, telling, gathering, and declaring-together. The operations belong to the QL unit because the unit itself counts by relating a distinction to its own two readings: `2 + 2² = 4+2`. Number is the relation becoming accountable to itself.

## QL placement

The language-field traverses the native six determinations:

| QL position | Linguistic operation | Authorial reading |
|---|---|---|
| `#0 · 0/1` | unnamed region | Tao, *Gegnet*, and the facing-field: encounter before the names of its terms |
| `#1 · ?/!` | cut that names and begins the count | *putare*, 制, assertion, denomination: a field marked strongly enough to be called to account |
| `#2 · −/+` | counter-facing | *contra*, *gegen*, *prati*, 向/嚮: encounter becoming energetic polarity without losing its axis |
| `#3 · X/x` | fitting and reckoning | a recurrent capacity becoming a countable instance, rule, ratio, kind, or pattern |
| `#4 · AM/IS` | domain and countenance | the personed region in which self-bearing, face, role, ruler, and ruled determination become mutually legible |
| `#5 · ∞/dx` | telling, gathering, recounting | *legein*, *logos*, tale, number, account: local marks composed into a telling that remains answerable to an unexhausted field |
| `5→0 · 1/0` | ordering without severance | the achieved account returns through the unnamed field; the great ordering does not cut the Way it articulates |

The Möbius turn is native to the field: `#5` gathering and recounting is the inverse face of `#1` naming and cutting. A name begins an account; a completed account returns the name to the encounter that first made it answerable.

- [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md|Taylor — Core Theorems Pithy (2026)]] supplies the native QL unit, six determinations, `2 + 2² = 4+2`, and the count's `5→0` return.
- [[symbolon/episteme/sources/chinese-philosophy/chung-yuan-chang/chung-yuan-chang-tao-a-new-way-of-thinking-2014/chung-yuan-chang-tao-a-new-way-of-thinking-2014.md|Chang Chung-yuan — Tao: A New Way of Thinking (2014)]] carries the Taoist encounter: the lived self-identity of opposites before intellectual unification, Tao as indistinct yet form-bearing, and region as open creativity.
- [[symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/heidegger/heidegger-1966-discourse-on-thinking/heidegger-1966-discourse-on-thinking.md|Heidegger — Discourse on Thinking (Anderson & Freund, 1966)]] supplies the calculative/meditative distinction and the calculative's failure to collect itself. - [[symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/heidegger/heidegger-1975-early-greek-thinking/heidegger-1975-early-greek-thinking.md|Heidegger — Early Greek Thinking (Krell & Capuzzi, 1975)]] carries *legein* as the laying that gathers and gives the Logos side of counting-as-recounting a declared source route.
- [[section-rooms/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn|Sym-Ballein]], [[section-rooms/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All|The Two Ones — Mono–Poly Matheme]], [[the-slash|The Slash (AND/OR)]], and [[section-rooms/arguments/A14-Computational-Process-Ontology|Computational Process Ontology]] carry the live QL argument to which the histories return.

## Essay use

The complete learning surface is [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/HISTORY|Encounter, Region, Countenance, and Count — The With-Field Becomes an Account]]. Use it when the essay needs the history of encounter becoming opposition, domain, name, count, and account. The source establishes the authorial synthesis; the etymological history distinguishes lexical descent, semantic field, graphic history, and QL operation without diminishing any of them into a weaker kind of claim.
